verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents an official CockroachDB Cloud MCP server. Agents can use it to explore live schemas and run read and write queries against any cluster, authenticating with OAuth or API keys. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and evidence of coverage beyond CockroachDB Cloud (e.g. self-hosted clusters) or of the detailed tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Your AI tools can explore live schemas and run queries against any cluster using OAuth or API key authentication.
A user can interact with their clusters using natural language prompts to perform read and write operations such as listing tables, executing statements, and inserting rows into a table.
